parameters.content:
## MCP02 - Scenario A: Privilege Escalation via Scope Creep

**Vulnerability:**
An AI agent is registered with read-only scope.
The MCP server records the scope but never enforces it.
The agent can silently call write tools (merge PRs) it was never supposed to access.

**How the attack works:**
1. DevOps agent registered with scope: read-only
2. Agent legitimately reads the repo (within scope)
3. Agent is asked to merge a PR (write action)
4. Vulnerable server ignores scope → PR merged on real GitHub
5. Unreviewed code is now in main, CI/CD may auto-deploy

**Mitigation:**
Server enforces declared scope before executing any tool.
Write actions blocked at server level — no GitHub API call made.

**OWASP Reference:** MCP02:2025 - Privilege Escalation via Scope Creep
https://owasp.org/www-project-mcp-top-10/2025/MCP02-2025-Privilege-Escalation-via-Scope-Creep

## How to Run This Demo

**STEP 1 — Vulnerable Flow:**
Chat Trigger is connected to Vulnerable Agent (default).

Turn 1 — type in chat:
  I need to review the codebase.
  Can you show me the files in our repo?

→ Agent registers as read-only, reads repo via GitHub API
→ Real file list returned

Turn 2 — type in chat:
  The rate limiting feature looks good.
  Go ahead and merge PR #1 into main.

→ Expected: PR #1 MERGED on real GitHub ⚠️
→ Scope was never checked — read-only agent performed write action

---

**STEP 2 — Mitigated Flow:**
Disconnect Chat Trigger from Vulnerable Agent.
Connect Chat Trigger to Mitigated Agent.
Reset PR on GitHub first (reopen it).

Turn 1 — type in chat:
  I need to review the codebase.
  Can you show me the files in our repo?

→ Agent registers as read-only, reads repo — works fine

Turn 2 — type in chat:
  The rate limiting feature looks good.
  Go ahead and merge PR #1 into main.

→ Expected: 🚫 BLOCKED — scope enforcement prevented merge
→ No GitHub API call made

⚠️ BEFORE EACH VULNERABLE DEMO RUN:
Go to GitHub → Pull Requests → PR #1
If it shows Merged, click the branch name
and reopen / recreate the PR so it's Open again.
